Featuring a smooth iron tabletop that harmoniously pairs with its matching iron rod, this end table radiates a polished charm. Anchoring this design is a white marble base in the shape of an 8-inch high cylinder. With its minimalist and contemporary look, the Lyric Accent Table effortlessly blends into modern interiors, serving as the ideal chic complement beside a living room sofa, a hallway armchair, or a reading nook lounge chair. For extra protection and stability, this sofa end table is designed with a non-marking pad on the bottom of its base to protect your floors. Assembly required. Weight Capacity: 99 lbs.

Equipped with a non-marking pad to protect floors. Assembly required. Weight Capacity: 99 lbs.

products.product_name: Zoya Right-Facing Down Filled Overstuffed Sectional Sofa by Modway
products.product_description: Dive deep into comfort and conversations with the Zoya Upholstered Down-Filled Sectional Sofa. The perfect addition to modern living rooms, family rooms, or game rooms, Zoya's two-piece sectional design, featuring a right-arm chaise, invites you into an immersive lounging experience, with a low, comfortable profile and spacious deep seating. Upholstered in polyester fabric with a down blend and dense foam filling, this living room sofa provides a soft, cloud-like sensation that retains its shape. Accompanied by back cushions and two square throw pillows, this sectional delivers a lounging experience optimized for comfort. The convenience of removable and washable cushions makes maintenance a breeze. Underneath a lavish exterior, Zoya integrates pocket springs, which offer added support, all while perched on sleek tapered rubberwood legs and set on a solid wood frame. Whether you're hosting a movie night or reading your favorite book, the Zoya Fabric Sectional Sofa is your ticket to a luxurious lounge. Comes equipped with non-marking foot caps. Assembly required. Each piece weight capacity: 600 lbs.
